children: LQR House appointed Lihong “Leo” Chen as Chief Executive Officer and Kit Yan “Mark” Lau as Chief Financial Officer, effective October 16, 2026, following the resignations of Sean Dollinger (CEO) and Kumar Abhishek (CFO).
Not disclosed (resignation; see Resignation Agreement referenced)
Not the result of any disagreement with the Company on operations, policies, or practices

Finance and business executive; 10+ years; former Chairman of Shenzhen Jincheng Confidentiality Technology Co., Ltd. (May 2022–Aug 2026); former GM, Financing Dept., Beijing Energy International Holdings (May 2016–May 2022); managed financing for 21 power station projects totaling over $1B; B.Management (Financial Management), Guangdong University of Finance and Economics; Master of Economics, University of Sydney.

Licensed accountant with financial leadership roles including CFO and finance manager at companies listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange; member of CISI and Institute of Public Accountants (Australia); Certified ESG Planner; Associate Member of The Hong Kong Chartered Governance Institute; degrees in accounting from Hong Kong Baptist University and the University of South Australia.
